She walked back toward the gate and did not look behind her. She knew now that nothing would ever be the same, and for now that was enough. The hatch stood open on a black corridor. Mara stepped inside. The air tasted of old oil and the cold of the hull came through her boots. The air tasted of old oil and the cold of the hull came through her boots. She counted the doors as she passed them and none of them would open.
